issue.title: more_like_this fails or silently returns no rows for NUMERIC fields

llm_context.input_title: more_like_this fails or silently returns no rows for NUMERIC fields
llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: The key-value form of `pdb.more_like_this` mishandles PostgreSQL `NUMERIC` fields. Specifically, `Numeric64` fields raise an internal query-construction error due to uncoerced string storage, and `NumericBytes` fields are silently ignored and return no rows because Tantivy MoreLikeThis ignores `Bytes` fields or lacks proper support.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: The query builder parses values from the seed row without accounting for schema-specific numeric storage representations (`Numeric64` and `NumericBytes`), passing raw string representations or un-scaled values into Tantivy's MoreLikeThis query engine which expects specific primitive types or correctly formatted byte encodings.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect pdb.more_like_this and numeric handling in pdb.rs
step_by_step_plan.description: Examine pg_search/src/api/builder_fns/pdb.rs to inspect how seed row values are retrieved and converted into PdbOwnedValue, specifically checking how Numeric64 and NumericBytes types are handled.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect query construction logic in pdb_query.rs
step_by_step_plan.description: Inspect pg_search/src/query/pdb_query.rs to understand how MoreLikeThis queries pass field values to Tantivy and how numeric type casting or conversion fails for Numeric64 and NumericBytes.

step_by_step_plan.title: Implement correct schema-aware type coercion for Numeric64 and NumericBytes
step_by_step_plan.description: Update the value conversion and query generation logic in pdb.rs and pdb_query.rs so that Numeric64 values are correctly mapped to integer types expected by Tantivy's MoreLikeThis query engine, and NumericBytes are either properly encoded or return a clear error.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add regression test and run test suite
step_by_step_plan.description: Add a new SQL/Rust regression test verifying that pdb.more_like_this successfully queries Numeric64 fields without raising an invalid value error, then run cargo test to verify the fix.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Translating database values into the exact internal format expected by search indexes based on field definitions.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Search indexes store numerical data in optimized formats (like fixed-point integers or byte arrays). Failing to convert database datums correctly leads to runtime type mismatch errors or silent query failures.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: The key-value path of `pdb.more_like_this` fails because it passes string-encoded values to fields expecting `Numeric64` or `NumericBytes` storage formats.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Handling PostgreSQL's arbitrary-precision numeric types within Tantivy search and retrieval queries.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: PostgreSQL numeric values have high precision and require special scaling or byte serialization to be indexed and queried efficiently in Rust search backends.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: `NUMERIC` fields can map to either `Numeric64` or `NumericBytes` representations in ParadeDB, each requiring distinct handling during query construction.

common_pitfalls: Assuming all numeric fields are stored as standard floating-point or 64-bit integers.
Forgetting to add proper error handling or validation for unsupported numeric storage types like `NumericBytes` in MoreLikeThis queries.
Modifying unrelated query builder functions outside the scope of `pdb.more_like_this`.
